recognize_zh: 淋巴結濾泡間區中央可見一團密集、胞質鮮紅的嗜酸性球聚集成嗜酸性微膿瘍（eosinophilic microabscess），周圍是小淋巴球、內皮細胞明顯的小血管與少量組織球，這是木村病（Kimura disease）的重要線索。
features: Dense central aggregate of eosinophils with bright red cytoplasmic granules forming a microabscess
Surrounding interfollicular infiltrate of small mature lymphocytes
Scattered eosinophils also dispersed in the adjacent interfollicular tissue
Associated histiocytes/epithelioid cells and small vessels with plump endothelium around the aggregate
No atypical large cells or Reed-Sternberg-like cells identified in this field
describe_en: Lymph node section shows an interfollicular area containing a well-circumscribed aggregate of eosinophils forming an eosinophilic microabscess, surrounded by histiocytes and small vessels. The background consists of small mature lymphocytes with additional scattered eosinophils. No atypical large lymphoid cells, Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, or granulomas with necrosis are identified. In the setting of florid follicular hyperplasia, peripheral eosinophilia, and elevated IgE, findings are consistent with Kimura disease.

ddx.vs: ALHE is a dermal/subcutaneous vascular lesion with epithelioid (histiocytoid) endothelial cells protruding into lumens, lacking the nodal follicular hyperplasia and IgE deposits of Kimura disease.
CHL contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the eosinophil-rich background, which are not seen here.
LCH shows sheets of Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei that are CD1a, langerin, and S100 positive, often in sinuses.
These may produce eosinophilic infiltrates but lack the characteristic IgE-coated germinal centers and vascular proliferation, and history or organism identification is decisive.
